name: ESQUE80
author: Lichthaus
summary: An 8-voice cross-wave synthesizer modelled on the Ensoniq SQ-80's architecture: three wavetable oscillators per voice, a 4-pole low-pass filter, four envelopes with live touch-editable displays, three LFOs and a 15-source mod matrix with tap-to-pick routing, across eleven touchscreen pages with Q-Link banks that follow each panel. Plays out of the box on built-in stand-in waves; add your own wave ROM for the original sound.
